data.name: Shikha
data.gender_notes: Shikha is used as a female name in hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Sanskrit śikhā, 'crest, peak, flame'. Its root is Sanskrit śikhā (शिखा). A classical Sanskrit term for a crest or flame. Shikha is a Sanskrit name meaning “Crest; peak; flame”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Shikha expresses “Crest; peak; flame”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Sanskrit śikhā, 'crest, peak, flame'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Shikha total 29, reducing to 2. Number 2 is associated with cooperation, sensitivity and balance.

vedic_reference.note: Shikha means line or edge, symbolizing the boundary between two things. In a spiritual context, it can also represent the line between the physical and spiritual worlds, or the boundary between ignorance and knowledge. It is also the name of the goddess Shikha, who is the personification of wisdom and knowledge.
